facts.summary: Phase 3 missed pre-specified primary analysis; benefit only in heavy-drinker subgroup · Phase 3 · AD04 in alcohol use disorder · not yet approved

evidence.summary: AD04 patients, compared with placebo patients, showed a trend in the reduction from baseline at month six in heavy drinking days for the combined trial population of heavy and very heavy drinkers (p=NS)
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: A similar, non-statistically significant trend was seen in the combined months five and six analysis in the reduction from baseline, which was the pre-specified primary efficacy analysis.
evidence.safety: No SAEs were determined to be related to AD04 treatment.
evidence.program_discontinued: we intend to advance AD04. We will work with regulatory authorities in Europe and the U.S. to achieve this goal.
